summary: Iteration 5 — Product & Search discovery (Related, Frequently Bought Together, Instant Search Suggestions, Image Zoom, slug 404 fix). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_discovery.py (10 pytest cases) — 10/10 PASS. Full regression across /app/tests/backend_test.py + test_auth_new.py + test_payment_hardening.py + test_orders_lifecycle.py (61 tests) — 61/61 PASS. UI validated end-to-end in browser: instant search suggestions dropdown, click-to-navigate, Enter->/products?search=term, product zoom, FBT section with 3 co-products + bundle price, 'Add all 4 to Bag' adding all items to cart (cart 0->4, subtotal ₹10,296), 'You May Also Like' related grid rendered. No new blockers for this feature set.
action_items: (Pre-existing, out-of-scope for this iteration but noticed) axios interceptor at /app/ecommerce-platform/client/src/services/api.js:99-102 redirects guests to /login on ANY 401, including public-page helper calls like /reviews/canReview. This causes a guest visiting /products/<slug> to be bounced to /login immediately. Consider excluding a small allow-list (canReview, wishlist status probes) or ignoring 401 when no auth token exists.
Carry-over from iteration_3: webhook prisma middleware ordering in server/index.js (POST /api/payments/webhook).
critical_code_review_comments: productRoutes.js correctly registers /suggestions, /:slug/related, /:slug/frequently-bought-together BEFORE the catch-all /:slug — good ordering, prevents 'suggestions' being treated as a slug.

productController.js now imports AppError (was the latent 500 ReferenceError on unknown slug) — verified fixed: GET /api/products/definitely-not-real-slug-zzz returns 404 with JSON error envelope, not 500.
getRelatedProducts falls back to featured/newest when the category is sparse — verified returns exactly 4 with SLUG excluded.
getFrequentlyBoughtTogether ranks by co-purchase frequency then falls back to same-category bestsellers — verified <=3 items, current product excluded.
getSearchSuggestions caps to 6, uses insensitive contains, empty q short-circuits to []. Select projection is lean (no full product joins).

ProductDetails.jsx zoom implementation applies transform:scale(2) with transformOrigin from mouse position on the element (not the data-testid container). Works correctly; testers should target the child img to read computed transform.

Header.jsx debounces suggestion fetches (250ms), clears suggestions on <2 chars, and re-uses api client which unwraps the {status,data} envelope. Popular tags only render when query.length<2 — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (search overlay, suggestions dropdown, suggestion click nav, Enter->search page, product-zoom-image, fbt-section, fbt-add-all, related grid all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test only reads existing seeded catalog (6 active products). FBT 'Add all' test added 4 items to the USER cart (Merino Wool Sweater + Essential Cotton Tee + Tailored Chino Trousers + Leather Derby Shoes). Consider clearing this cart between runs if state matters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discovery endpoints are stable and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_discovery.py. Data-testids to trust: search-open, search-input, search-suggestions, suggestion-, search-close, product-zoom-image (transform lives on child ), fbt-section, fbt-add-all. Slug 404 no longer crashes. Pre-existing 401->/login redirect in api.js interceptor caused guest visits to product pages to bounce; workaround for testing is to log in first (as done here).
